newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends bourse at new record close.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends bourse at new record close.

text.p: 1249 GMT - German DAX ends bourse trade at new record closing level, market now looking to Wall Street and U.S. data at 1330 GMT. SAP surge the main feature of floor session. Talk of need for short term consolidation still in market.
* DAX index up 17.83 points at 3,035.15, a record close and just off all-time intraday high of 3,041.55.
* March DTB DAX futures up nine at 3,037 points.
* Allianz down, profit-taking cited after stock's rally on Goldman upgrade, Deutsche also lower.
* Porsche solidly up on earnings report.
